items.name: Order backlog and order intake, FY2025
items.claim: With an order intake of EUR 4,710 million in FY2025, HENSOLDT increased order volume over the previous year by 62 percent (previous year: EUR 2,904 million); as a result, its order backlog rose by one third to EUR 8,833 million (previous year: EUR 6,644 million), and the book-to-bill ratio rose to 1.9x.
items.source_excerpt: With an order intake of EUR 4,710 million, HENSOLDT increased the order volume of the previous year by 62% (previous year: EUR 2,904 million). As a result, the order backlog rose by one third to EUR 8,833 million (previous year: EUR 6,644 million). Revenue rose by close to 10% to EUR 2,455 million (previous year: EUR 2,240 million). Despite various operational transformation initiatives that form the basis for future growth, HENSOLDT was able to steadily convert orders into the implementation of project milestones and deliveries. The book-to-bill ratio, which rose to 1.9x, underscores the structural acceleration in demand and lays the foundation for further growth.

notes: HENSOLDT is a German foreign private issuer with no EDGAR filings; sourced from the stored FY2025 results press release fetched to data/web/5b6dfa49148d7004.json (200, stored text).
